mathematical_contract.carrier: A retained cusp semicircle is a one-word oriented subfragment of one clone-shared exact cusp frame. Its point, tangent, reversal, incidence, bounds, winding, and parameter cuts remain canonical-Real expressions tied to the selected source isolator.
mathematical_contract.diagonal_deflation: For a source-related cusp/parallel pair, the authored source parameter is substituted into the bivariate system over its local quotient field. The exact factor y-alpha is divided until the residual is nonzero, preserving the complete known contact multiplicity rather than treating a correlated root as two independent algebraic values.
mathematical_contract.root_free_join: After diagonal deflation, an exact tensor-Bernstein restriction over the retained parameter box may exclude every residual root only when all coefficients have one strict certified sign. Subdivision preserves this certificate; an endpoint sign reversal proves a root and cannot be accepted as a negative result.
mathematical_contract.projection_fallback: When the local sign certificate does not decide the supported case, the fiber is projected through the quotient-ring multiplication determinant. Defining degree is capped at eight to bound matrix and coefficient growth; a declined cap is explicit uncertainty, never a negative intersection.
mathematical_contract.endpoint_contact: A structurally shared source endpoint is authoritative construction evidence. It is not replayed as an independent-root radical equality; the tangent cross is retained as exact zero contact evidence.
mathematical_contract.topology: Simple-loop acceptance inspects the completed split topology and certified successor graph. It does not infer simplicity from a parallel-only family shortcut.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT accepts only exact or certified decisions. APPROXIMATE_512 traverses the same exact graph and may terminate only at Hyperlimit's 512-bit equality boundary; returned geometry remains exact and consumption is reported. Default and minimal builds use the same Hypersolve policy surface.

capability.comparison_revision: General algebraic cusp carriers are retained as exact split fragments, but a complete CurveRegion2 loop containing them cannot pass pair/split/traversal regularization.
capability.source_revision: Direct cusp/parallel joins, their reversed-source equivalents, and one complementary two-cusp full-circle loop regularize through CurveRegion2 under both policies with exact retained topology.
capability.no_primitive_element: Topology-shared contacts use correlated local-field or structural endpoint evidence. No primitive-element tower is constructed for the admitted loop.
capability.bounded_failure: High-degree global resultants and unbounded local-field Sturm work were rejected after measuring an approximately 1.1 GiB allocation cliff and nontermination beyond one minute on the degree-12 workload. Declined bounded paths remain explicit rather than weakening exactness.

benchmark.primary_method: release executables pinned to CPU 11; seven perf-stat process repetitions; deterministic instruction and branch counts are authoritative because task clock and cycles varied with host frequency

new_capability.workload: one process constructs direct normal/reversed cusp-to-parallel joins and regularizes a complementary general-algebraic-cusp full circle under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512
new_capability.interpretation: This is the first complete exact capability baseline; the comparison revision blocks before producing equivalent topology.

matched_existing_guard.interpretation: The small deterministic increase includes one additional registered unit test in the current harness; existing exact cusp/parallel work remains effectively neutral.

fixed_work_historical_controls.interpretation: Both unrelated production controls are instruction-neutral. Wall time and cycles are intentionally not used for the regression claim because matched processes observed large frequency and scheduler drift.

competitive_context.method: current release comparative executable pinned to CPU 11; eleven samples targeted at 100 ms; fixture construction excluded
competitive_context.interpretation: Curvo and Cavalier operate on finite binary64 geometry and do not retain canonical-Real algebraic carriers, exact region topology, or policy certainty. They are throughput targets rather than correctness peers.

new_capability.interpretation: Exact tensor-Bernstein restriction and bigint/rational arithmetic dominate the new capability's allocation count; this is explicit performance debt for the next hardening tranche.

matched_existing_guard.interpretation: The unchanged exact guard is allocation-neutral; the twelve-call difference is consistent with the extra current test registration.

release_size.method: matched curve_region_boolean_batch release executables at source and comparison revisions against identical live dependency contents
release_size.interpretation: The exact capability adds modest but measurable linked text. No compatibility shim or second public engine is introduced; cold outlining and deletion of displaced machinery remain required size work.

policy_feature_matrix.latent_comparison_failure: At the comparison revision, both default-feature policy tests pass, but the no-default-feature variants return Uncertain(RealSign) before reaching the expected ordering policy boundary.
policy_feature_matrix.cause: The minimal build bypassed Hyperlimit and used an independent fixed -512 Real refinement fallback for scalar sign/order decisions.
policy_feature_matrix.fix: Hypersolve reexports the authoritative scalar predicate outcome, sign, certainty, and policy functions; Hypercurve consumes that surface unconditionally and retains direct Hyperlimit only for optional geometric predicates.
policy_feature_matrix.strict: The nested-radical comparison remains explicitly uncertain without consuming a terminal.
policy_feature_matrix.approximate_512: The same comparison terminates as equal at the 512-bit boundary and reports Approximate512Consumed.
policy_feature_matrix.geometry: No approximate coordinate or replacement curve is published.
